text: A circuit breaker trips open after repeated failures and recovers on a timeout, protecting a downstream service from being hammered while it is unhealthy.
A write-ahead log records every mutation to durable storage before applying it, so a crash can be recovered by replaying the log.
A gossip protocol spreads membership and state updates across distributed nodes by having each node periodically exchange information with a few random peers.
A token-bucket rate limiter refills tokens at a fixed rate; a request is allowed only if a token is available, smoothing bursts to an average rate.
An LRU cache evicts the least-recently-used entry when full, keeping hot keys resident; add a TTL to also expire stale entries by time.
Consistent hashing maps keys and nodes onto a ring so that adding or removing a node only remaps a small fraction of keys, with virtual nodes for balance.
Two-phase commit coordinates an atomic transaction across participants: a prepare phase where everyone votes, then a commit or abort phase driven by the coordinator.
A Bloom filter is a probabilistic set that answers membership with no false negatives and tunable false positives, using several hash functions over a bit array.
